description: Lists every AI tool configuration on this machine and every tool each one exposes at the config level, plus which agent hosts could not be checked and why. AI tools whose connectors live in your provider account, not a local file, so they are always reported UNVERIFIABLE by design with where to check instead - never silently omitted. Free and stateless: this call has no memory of a prior one, so it lists what is configured, it does not detect what changed since you last looked. Nothing you submit is stored, logged, or retained.
name: inventory_ai_agents
